ICS: Before we get started, I want to give you a little background on the program.

We are a free service that connects families with resources in their neighborhood. These include resources related to food access, nutrition education, and physical activity. Our goal in doing this is to support your decision to live an active and healthy lifestyle. After learning more about your needs through our conversation, I will create and send you a custom tailored list of things to do, programs to sign up for, and classes to take, specific to your interests.
With that being said, this initial conversation will be quite thorough and will last about 10-15 minutes.
